tagline.en_US: A self-hosted full-text search engine with an HTTP API and a built-in API explorer. This profile stores the index data persistently and generates a master key.

description.en_US: Meilisearch is an open-source search engine designed for fast full-text, semantic, and hybrid search. It provides search-as-you-type results with built-in typo tolerance, sorting, and faceted filtering. Applications connect to it through a RESTful API to index documents and retrieve relevant results.
